mapper.sql: select project_code, project_name, receive_status, stamp_status, check_status, customer_name, manager_user_name, second_check_time, receive_cutoff_time, yj_user_name, yjsj, sj_user_name, sjsj, zgsj, rectify_cutoff_time, gzsj, ys_user_name, yssj, is_archive, job_org_name from view_bcyj
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.job_org_name, a.project_code_year, a.project_code_type, a.project_code_seq, a.project_code_custom, a.project_type_id, a.total_check_status, a.work_status, a.id, a.project_name, a.project_code, a.customer_name, a.customer_id, a.manager_user_id, a.manager_user_name, a.branch_org_id, a.branch_org_name, a.level, a.sync_source, a.project_check_instance_id, a.create_time, pc.check_time as second_check_time, e.* FROM project a INNER JOIN project_check pc ON a.id = pc.project_id RIGHT JOIN ( SELECT a.is_archive, a.id AS transferId, a.project_id, a.transfer_user_id, a.transfer_user_name, a.transfer_status, a.transfer_time, a.check_status, a.receive_status, a.stamp_status, a.receive_cutoff_time, a.rectify_cutoff_time, a.is_need_stamp, a.is_need_electronic_stamp, a.version, a.is_new_archive_transfer, b.* FROM project_archive_transfer a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DISTINCT a.id, MAX(ystgsj) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS ystgsj, LAST_VALUE(ys_tg_user_id) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS ys_tg_user_id, LAST_VALUE(ys_tg_user_name) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS ys_tg_user_name, MAX(yssj) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS yssj, LAST_VALUE(ys_user_id) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS ys_user_id, LAST_VALUE(ys_user_name) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS ys_user_name, MAX(yjsj) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS yjsj, LAST_VALUE(yj_user_id) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS yj_user_id, LAST_VALUE(yj_user_name) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS yj_user_name, MAX(sjsj) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS sjsj, LAST_VALUE(sj_user_id) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS sj_user_id, LAST_VALUE(sj_user_name) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS sj_user_name, MAX(gzsj) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS gzsj, LAST_VALUE(gz_user_id) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS gz_user_id, LAST_VALUE(gz_user_name) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS gz_user_name, MIN(zgsj) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS zgsj, FIRST_VALUE(zg_user_id) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS zg_user_id, FIRST_VALUE(zg_user_name) OVER (PARTITION BY a.id) AS zg_user_name FROM project_archive_transfer a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.create_time AS yssj, t.create_user_id AS ys_user_id, t.create_user_name AS ys_user_name, t.bo_id FROM business_operate t WHERE t.type = 204 AND t.step_code = 'check_done' ) b ON a.id = b.bo_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.create_time AS yjsj, t.create_user_id AS yj_user_id, t.create_user_name AS yj_user_name, t.bo_id FROM business_operate t WHERE t.type = 204 AND t.step_code = 'transfer_done' ) c ON a.id = c.bo_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.create_time AS sjsj, t.create_user_id AS sj_user_id, t.create_user_name AS sj_user_name, t.bo_id FROM business_operate t WHERE t.type = 204 AND t.step_code = 'receive_done' ) d ON a.id = d.bo_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.create_time AS gzsj, t.create_user_id AS gz_user_id, t.create_user_name AS gz_user_name, t.bo_id FROM business_operate t WHERE t.type = 204 AND t.step_code = 'stamp_done' ) e ON a.id = e.bo_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.create_time AS zgsj, t.create_user_id AS zg_user_id, t.create_user_name AS zg_user_name, t.bo_id FROM business_operate t WHERE t.type = 204 AND t.step_code = 'refuse_done' ) f ON a.id = f.bo_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.create_time AS ystgsj, t.create_user_id AS ys_tg_user_id, t.create_user_name AS ys_tg_user_name, t.bo_id FROM business_operate t WHERE t.type = 204 AND t.step_code = 'check_pass_done' ) g ON a.id = g.bo_id ) b ON a.id = b.id ) e ON a.id = e.project_id
and a.project_code like concat('%', #{projectCode}, '%') and a.project_name like concat('%', #{projectName}, '%') and a.customer_name like concat('%', #{customerName}, '%') and a.manager_user_name like concat('%', #{managerUserName}, '%') and a.job_org_name like concat('%', #{jobOrgName}, '%') and e.receive_status = #{receiveStatus} and e.stamp_status = #{stampStatus} and e.check_status = #{checkStatus} and a.create_time >= '2024-01-01 00:00:00' and e.is_archive != 0 and a.branch_org_id = '1352137951374610444' AND pc.stage = 200 AND pc.status = 1
ORDER BY e.transfer_status asc, pc.check_time DESC ,e.transfer_time DESC NULLS LAST, a.project_code DESC NULLS LAST ) t
